title: Sign in
intro: Access is restricted to the site's administration.
notAllowed: This Authentik account is not allowed to manage the site.
emailNotVerified: Authentik has not verified the email address of this account.
emailNotFound: Authentik did not provide an email address for this account.
stateMismatch: The Authentik sign-in expired or was opened in another tab. Start again.
invalidCode: Authentik rejected the sign-in code. Start again.
userInfo: Your Authentik profile could not be read. Check the provider configuration.
restart: The Authentik sign-in expired. Start again.
failed: Sign-in failed. Try again, or use the other method.
tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
invalidEmail: This email address is not valid.
passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off: use Authentik.
throttled: Too many failed attempts for this account: wait a few seconds before trying again.
authentikDown: Authentik cannot be reached right now (code {code}).
noMethod: No sign-in method is set up.
